Reading notes on Deep Work. The author argues that small, frequent reviews beat rare, large ones. I am not fully convinced, because the evidence comes from software teams, and my work is mostly writing. Still, the idea of a fixed weekly slot is worth a try. Quote: "Attention is the scarcest resource you manage."
